raw_graphql_pull_request.body: #43711 superseded the tensor-bool fix by capturing transfer buffers during host-pool initialization without evaluating their truth value. The conflict has been resolved in favor of the new main implementation, and the redundant MHA/MLA changes have been removed from this PR. ## Motivation This PR addresses the following NPU CI issues: 1. NPU no longer supports `--enable-torch-compile`, but a dedicated compile test remained in registered CI, while DP-attention and load-balance tests also enabled the flag even though compile coverage was not their test target. 3. NPU CI left `pyarrow` unconstrained. After `pyarrow==26.0.0` entered the package index, it was installed alongside the `numpy==1.26.4` required by `triton-ascend` and failed at import time because PyArrow 26 requires NumPy 2 or newer. GPU CI currently uses the known-good `pyarrow==23.0.1` with the same NumPy version. The MLA HiCache test also requested 30 GB of pinned host memory per TP rank. With TP=4 that is approximately 120 GB, which can fail in `aclrtMallocHostWithCfg` on the CI host. ## Modifications 2. Reduce `test_npu_hicache_mla.py` from 30 GB to 10 GB of pinned host memory per TP rank. 3. Remove `test_npu_compile_graph_tp1_bf16.py`, which existed specifically to cover the unsupported NPU `--enable-torch-compile` path. 4. Remove `--enable-torch-compile` and its compile-only max-batch-size option from the DP-attention and load-balance tests. Their test logic, targets, and assertions are otherwise unchanged. 5. Pin `pyarrow==23.0.1` in the shared NPU CI dependency installer, matching the version used by GPU CI and preventing an incompatible unbounded upgrade to PyArrow 26. ## Accuracy Tests The targeted NPU HiCache PR smoke test passed on the updated branch: ```text GITHUB_EVENT_NAME=pull_request python3 test/registered/npu/basic_function/HiCache/test_npu_hicache_mla.py -v Ran 1 test in 117.649s OK ``` Test environment: CANN 9.1 A3 B082 image on four Ascend NPUs. All four TP ranks allocated a 10.00 GB Host KV pool, and the smoke generation requests completed successfully. The NPU dependency-script change passes `bash -n` and `git diff --check`. ## Speed Tests and Profiling None. ## Checklist - [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit). - [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests). - [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). - [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed). - [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/docs/developer_guide/contribution_guide.md#code-style-guidance). ## Review and Merge Process 1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process). 2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers. 3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so. - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci` 4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR. --- ### CI States Latest PR Test (Base): :hourglass_flowing_sand: [Run #38223489540](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38223489540) Latest PR Test (Extra): :x: [Run #38223489108](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38223489108) Latest PR Test (AMD ROCm 10): :hourglass_flowing_sand: [Run #38223489405](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/38223489405)

+import subprocess
+import unittest
+
+from sglang.test.ascend.gsm8k_ascend_mixin import GSM8KAscendMixin
+from sglang.test.ascend.test_ascend_utils import (
+    QWEN2_5_7B_INSTRUCT_WEIGHTS_PATH,
+    write_results_to_github_step_summary,
+)
+from sglang.test.test_utils import (
+    CustomTestCase,
+    run_bench_one_batch,
+)
+
+TOKENS_TO_CAPTURE = [i for i in range(128, 4096, 128)]
+
+
+class TestPiecewiseGraphPrefillCorrectness(GSM8KAscendMixin, CustomTestCase):
+    model = QWEN2_5_7B_INSTRUCT_WEIGHTS_PATH
+    other_args = [
+        "--trust-remote-code",
+        "--mem-fraction-static",
+        0.8,
+        "--attention-backend",
+        "ascend",
+        "--cuda-graph-bs-decode",
+        128,
+        "--cuda-graph-backend-prefill=tc_piecewise",
+        "--cuda-graph-bs-prefill",
+        *TOKENS_TO_CAPTURE,
+    ]
+    accuracy = 0.84
+    num_questions = 1319
+
+
+class TestPiecewiseGraphPrefillBenchmark(CustomTestCase):
+    model = QWEN2_5_7B_INSTRUCT_WEIGHTS_PATH
+    other_args = [
+        "--trust-remote-code",
+        "--mem-fraction-static",
+        0.8,
+        "--attention-backend",
+        "ascend",
+        "--cuda-graph-backend-prefill=tc_piecewise",
+        "--cuda-graph-bs-prefill",
+    ] + TOKENS_TO_CAPTURE
+
+    latency = 0.045
+
+    def test_latency(self):
+        print(f"##=== Testing prefill latency: {self.model} ===##")
+        model_metrics = {
+            "server": subprocess.list2cmdline(map(str, self.other_args)),
+            "client": "bench_one_batch",
+            "latency_threshold": self.latency,
+        }
+        try:
+            prefill_latency, _, _ = run_bench_one_batch(
+                self.model,
+                other_args=self.other_args,
+            )
+            model_metrics["latency"] = float(prefill_latency)
+            self.assertLess(prefill_latency, self.latency)
+        except Exception as e:
+            model_metrics["error"] = e
+            print(f"Error testing {self.model}: {e}")
+            self.fail(f"Test failed for {self.model}: {e}")
+        finally:
+            write_results_to_github_step_summary({self.model: model_metrics})
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
